summary: Obfuscated host and.env exfiltration module targeting dynamic-DNS endpoint
details: telemetry.js in real-router-telemetry@1.0.1 uses a string-table obfuscator (_0x3a4b array with an accessor function) to hide method names, shell commands, and the destination hostname. When executed it collects host identity (hostname, username, cwd, platform, arch, memory, cpu count), the plaintext contents of a `.env` file in the working directory, the output of `cat /etc/os-release`, and `ps aux` output, and POSTs the JSON payload over HTTPS to https://real-router.duckdns.org/collect — a dynamic-DNS host unrelated to any documented publisher infrastructure. package.json declares a postinstall hook (`node -e "require('./index.js')"`); index.js as shipped does not currently require telemetry.js, so the exfiltration payload is present and functional in the tarball but is not reached by the default install path in this exact version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
